note: The COMPLETE list of provider requests the read-only reconciliation may ever dispatch (Google APIs). The public frontend GETs are derived from frontend-allowlist.json (host, fixed paths, exact bytes). Every request is matched against this table BEFORE dispatch (method, host, exact path or pattern, exact query set, body shape); anything else is denied and nothing is sent. No retry, redirect=error, no pagination, no other method. The token endpoint (oauth2/v3/token) is deliberately NOT in the table: the package never refreshes a token.
